title: Growth sentence-wrapper auto-selection audit
scope: 45 narrative families, final stage of each family, current noun-collision filter, top 5 wrappers by auto_priority

finding.primary: For non-quotation dimensions, top-5 auto selection is almost completely determined by auto_priority rather than semantic compatibility.
evidence: 出来事 10/10 families have the same top five: say-topic, hear-topic, state-topic, ask-topic, narrate-topic.
関係 6/6 families have the same top five.
場所, 理由, 状況, 属性, 時間, 存在 show the same pattern.
ask-topic appears in the top five of 30/45 families even when the inner sentence is declarative.

existing_strength.semantic_gap: wrapper speech-act/role is not used in automatic ranking

research_hypotheses: Question wrappers should require interrogative evidence before automatic selection.
Specialized read/write/ack/tell/reply wrappers should be preferred mainly for quotation/hearsay contexts.
Reaction wrappers should not enter general auto-selection merely because their priority is numerically low enough after lexical conflicts.
General reporting wrappers may remain broad fallbacks.
next: Create a conservative wrapper semantic-role gate and simulate it on the same 45 final-stage contexts before any public behavior change.
